Given two $n\times n$ matrices $M$ and $N,$ we have

$$
det(MN)=det(M)\cdot det(N).
$$

In our case, this gives

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B) & =det[\begin{aligned}6\sqrt{2} & -5 \\ 1 & 2\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}]\cdot det[\begin{aligned}7 & 3 \\ -4 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =(24-(-5))\cdot (-14-(-12)) \\  & =29\cdot (-2) \\  & =-58.\end{aligned}
$$
